name: keep-your-prompts
description: Search, save, reuse, improve and version your prompts from Gemini CLI with Keep Your Prompts, plus optional capture of the prompts you type into your inbox.

settings.name: API key
settings.description: Keep Your Prompts workspace API key (kyp_live_...). Create one at app.keepyourprompts.com > Settings > API keys.

settings.name: Capture prompts
settings.description: Set to 1 to send each prompt you type in Gemini CLI to your Keep Your Prompts inbox (secrets are redacted on your machine first). Leave empty to turn capture off.
